label: UI
title: Validation Rules | Edit validation rule dialog: fields touch the dialog edges and label / option styles are inconsistent
env: NDC CRM · Settings › Modules and Fields › Validation Rules › Edit validation rule · Edge

panels.caption: Edit validation rule: the header has padding, the body does not; labels and radio groups use two different styles

rows: Same inner padding as the header (about 20 px) on left and right
Labels, inputs, dropdowns and radios start at the dialog's left border; inputs run up to the scrollbar on the right; "Rule name" sits on the header divider
One style for all field labels
"Rule name *" / "Description" in sentence case; "LAYOUT" / "FIELD TO CHECK" (same kind of field label) in uppercase section style
"When the rule is broken" options stacked with hints; "Show the error" options side by side
